digest.component_or_area: CLI explain guides and author documentation packaging
propositions: Packaged CLI author guides contain consumer-relative markdown link targets (review-policy.md, CONTRIBUTING.md, etc.) that dangle for repo-less clients running rebar explain
The commit-trailer format (EXPECTED_FORMAT in verify_commit.py) has no first-class CLI-discoverable home; only buried in rebar verify-commit-ticket --help
Dangling references must be repointed to hosted https:// URLs for repo docs or rebar explain <topic> for sibling guides, with no bare repo-relative paths allowed
The MCP explain_criterion tool docstring lists only plan/review guides but AUTHOR_GUIDES registry is dynamic, creating drift risk
Packaged guides need a guard test enforcing that all markdown link targets resolve for non-rebar clients (allowed: https://, http://, #anchors, mailto: only)
